title: Love Love Love this collectible Micheal the Archangel!!!
text: Love Love Love this collectible Micheal the Archangel!!!. I ordered this Beautiful Micheal  statue that is breathtaking. I am totally amazed at the quality (& the low price)and so happy for the purchase that I plan on purchasing more for my display case  in the future. I also want to give several as gifts to my closest friends to start their own collection with.  Thank you so Very Much for these  Magnificent Statues!!!!❤️❤️🙏🏼🙏🏼
